subject: [PATCH 2/3] perf/core: Don't let BPF programs read an uninitialized sample address

reviews.author: tip-bot2 for Usama Arif
reviews.summary: Merged the patch into the perf/urgent branch of tip without any comments or concerns.

2026-11-19.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a perf/core issue where BPF programs can read uninitialized sample addresses, leading to potential security vulnerabilities. The patch introduces a check in bpf_overflow_handler() to clear the address field of bpf_perf_event_data if it's not set by PERF_SAMPLE_ADDR. This ensures that BPF programs only access valid and initialized data.
